faults.quote: Unlike some other locations, you don't typically add 'place' (地方) after it
faults.why: Bizarre claim; place nouns in Chinese never take 地方 after them to mean 'go to'.
Should mention the classifier 家 (jiā) and the polyphonic character 行 (háng vs. xíng).
